hypothesis_title: Requirement-Checklist Extraction Instruction Raises Held-Out Pass Rate
hypothesis_claim: Appending the instruction 'Before writing any code, extract every requirement stated in the task and docstrings into a numbered checklist. Before finishing, verify your implementation against each numbered item and fix any item that fails.' raises a small coding agent's held-out-test pass rate versus a no-instruction baseline on spec-dense tasks.
baseline_description: Agent defaults: identical prompt, model, tools, and limits with no appended system prompt.
intervention: Before writing any code, extract every requirement stated in the task and docstrings into a numbered checklist. Before finishing, verify your implementation against each numbered item and fix any item that fails.
